note: Rejudged after adding TestRFC1661TerminateAckAcrossAllStates (rfc1661_rtr_ruc_states_test.go) and after 7db39c4b2d replaced checkPPPCodeReject's constant-arg fail(7, parseErr) closure with equivalent pppCodeRejectFailure(name, 7, parseErr). Re-read RFC 1661 Section 5.5 ('Upon reception of a Terminate-Request, a Terminate-Ack MUST be transmitted.') and Section 4.1 row RTR. The former whole-row gap (untagged non-Opened states) is closed: TestRFC1661TerminateAckAcrossAllStates drives handleLCPPacket with Terminate-Request (Identifier 0x77) in all eight packet-receiving states (Closed, Stopped, Closing, Stopping, Req-Sent, Ack-Rcvd, Ack-Sent, Opened), asserting the exact Section 4.1 next state, exact ended boolean, exactly one LCP frame, Code Terminate-Ack and echoed Identifier 0x77 (dropping LCPActSTA from any state's LCPEventRTR arm in LCPDoTransition fails that state's subtest). Existing TestRFC1661TerminateAckSentAndLinkHeld keeps the Opened no-EventSessionDown check, TestRFC1661NoTerminateAckForTerminateAck provides the negative control (Terminate-Ack draws no Terminate-Ack), and checkPPPCodeReject proves live xl2tpd/pppd Terminate-Ack echoing Identifier 0x5a.
